bbk_sharkstorm_special.title: The Late-Night Sharkstorm Special
bbk_sharkstorm_special.//: Story Phase 17 (chapter 215): a late-night talk show from somewhere inside the storm, on the galley's set: a set made of treasure chests, an audience of sharks, a hammerhead orchestra, cartoon versions of the crew, the two visitors as live correspondents. It recaps the new arrivals and laughs at the captain. Interruptions fail. Original material.

beats.line: announcer: IT'S LATE! IT'S LIVE! IT'S... THE BLING BLING KING'S LATE-NIGHT SHARKSTORM SPECIAL!
hammerheads: (a brass fanfare played entirely by sharks)
bbk_special: Thank you, thank you. What a crowd. What a STORM. Tonight's episode, folks: MEET... THE NEW... DEAD IDIOTS!
bbk_special: You know the ship. You know the beard. You know the cardboard guy, folks. Well now there's THREE cardboard guys.
bbk_special: How'd they get there? A FART, folks. Out of a CUPBOARD. Into a BOX. That's not a resurrection. That's a delivery.
bbk_special: The new one's an ACCOUNTANT. He's got a column called MAYBE. He's put my STORM in it. Folks, I'm a MAYBE.
bbk_special: And he's invented a currency. CAPTAIN MINUTES. Backed by the captain's suffering. Folks, I checked the exchange rate. It's the strongest currency in the sea.
bbk_special: Then there's the first mate. She's ninety-one, she's cardboard, and she tried to steer my storm to a place called GREYHOOK. Ma'am. Ma'am. You're IN me.
bbk_special: And the chicken! Let's hear it for the chicken, folks!
shark_audience: (a whole storm of sharks, applauding a chicken)
bbk_special: We've got correspondents on board, folks! Embedded! Let's go live to the galley!
bbk_special: (wiping his sunglasses) The whole crew, folks. Smart as a bag of sashes. The captain? He's watching. He's furious. Captain, if you're watching: we LOVE you. We love watching you.
bbk_special: Goodnight, Sharkstorm! Tip your sharks!
